claim: *Three distinct relations.* Correspondence tests agreement between representations; conformance tests an artifact against an independent obligation; acceptance asks whether the receiving environment will take the result. Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.

topology.description: Three unordered comparison bands; symmetric correspondence vs directed conformance and acceptance.

required_terms: Evidence for one relation does not establish the others.
bw_encoding: All compared endpoint nodes white; band headings and relation labels distinguish correspondence, conformance and acceptance.
redesign: All compared endpoint nodes white; band headings and relation labels distinguish correspondence, conformance and acceptance. Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
alt: Three stacked bands distinguish correspondence, conformance and acceptance. Correspondence links two internal representations in both directions. Conformance asks whether an artifact satisfies an independent obligation. Acceptance asks whether a receiving environment will take it. The three provide different evidence.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Gray distinguishes representation, independent obligation and receiving environment; bidirectional correspondence and directed conformance/acceptance retained.
